title: 计划与打算
goal: 会说接下来的打算（明天、周末、明年），听懂 Are you going to ...? / What are your plans? 并回答。
tips: 已经决定的计划用 be going to：I'm going to visit my parents. 已经约好的用现在进行时：I'm meeting Tom at six.
临时决定、承诺用 will：I'll call you later. / I'll help you.
不确定：I might ... / I'm thinking about ...ing（我在考虑……）

exchanges.hear: What are your plans for the weekend?
exchanges.reply: I'm going to visit my grandparents.

exchanges.hear: Are you going to the party tonight?
exchanges.reply: I might. It depends on how I feel.
exchanges.replyZh: 可能去，看我感觉怎么样。

exchanges.hear: What are you doing after work?
exchanges.reply: I'm meeting a friend for dinner.

exchanges.hear: Do you have any big plans for next year?
I can't carry all these bags.
What's your goal for this year?
exchanges.reply: I want to save money and travel abroad.
exchanges.replyZh: 我想存钱，然后出国旅行。

exchanges.hear: Call me when you get home, OK?
exchanges.hearZh: 到家给我打个电话，好吗？

lines.en: So, what are your plans for next year?
lines.zh: 那么，你明年有什么计划？

lines.en: I'm going to take an English course. I want to travel more.
lines.zh: 我打算上个英语课，我想多去旅行。

lines.en: That's a great goal. Where do you want to go?
I might go to Australia. My cousin lives there.
lines.zh: 可能去澳大利亚，我表姐住在那儿。

lines.en: Cool! When are you thinking of going?
Maybe in March. I need to save some money first.
lines.zh: 也许三月吧。我得先存点钱。

lines.en: Good idea. I'm going to change jobs next year, hopefully.
lines.zh: 好主意。我明年打算换工作，但愿能成。

lines.en: Really? What kind of job are you looking for?
lines.zh: 真的？你想找什么样的工作？

lines.en: Something in design. I'll start applying soon.
lines.zh: 设计方面的。我很快就开始投简历。

lines.en: Good luck! I'm sure you'll find something great.
lines.zh: 祝你好运！你一定能找到好工作。
